data.text:
The transport group Samahang Manibela Mananakay at nagka Isang Terminal ng Transportasyon (MANIBELA) on Thursday said its transport strike remains in effect despite dismantling its organized protest centers.

According to MANIBELA chairman Mar Valbuena, the strike continues in the absence of physical picket lines.
